ma.getSavedFileList(Object object)

Obtain the list of locally cached files of the Mini Program.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getSavedFileList: ok
fileList Array File array. Each item is an attribute of fileItem.
fileItem
Attribute Type Description
filePath String Local file path.
size Number Size of the local file, in byte.
createTime Number Timestamp when a file is saved, which is the number of seconds from 1970/01/01 08:00:00 to the current time.

Sample Code

ma.getSavedFileList({
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.fileList);
  }
});

Tips

  1. Support calling through FileSystemManager
